subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should existing write-scoped Gateway clients be intentionally denied when reusing a keyed session to change its selected model or thinking level?
rationale: This is a deliberate fail-closed compatibility change at a core authorization boundary; source and proof establish the mechanics, but they cannot establish the intended upgrade policy.

options.title: Confirm the admin-only boundary
options.body: Treat changed selection on an adopted keyed session as an administrative reconfiguration, rebase the PR, and land with the documented upgrade behavior.

options.title: Preserve write-scoped reconfiguration
options.body: Keep the existing write-scoped behavior and close or redesign this patch if model and thinking selection are not intended to be privileged operations.

options.title: Define a narrower supported route
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers specify a separate scoped operation or migration path for trusted write-scoped clients that must reconfigure adopted sessions.

recommendation.title: Confirm the admin-only boundary
recommendation.body: Treat changed selection on an adopted keyed session as an administrative reconfiguration, rebase the PR, and land with the documented upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely routing candidate for a core Gateway security-and-compatibility policy choice.
